name: solar-ptz-central
description: Central portal/dashboard for Ubox and V380 Solar PTZ Cameras

scripts.dev:win: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server
scripts.check:server: curl http://localhost:3001/api/health || echo Server offline - run npm run dev:server
